description: The associate runs API, reached on the loopback of the machine that holds the dedicated checkout: http.call runs where this actor lives. The improvement flow starts a run with POST /runs (role admin) and reads it with GET /runs/{id} (role viewer), so the service token needs the admin role; stored in grant as ASSOCIATE_BRIDGE_SERVICE_TOKEN and injected into the engine node's unit. The port 8794 in the workflow is a placeholder: set it to the port the associate bridge listens on.
name: associate bridge
